groups.label: Extra events
groups.scope: Compare the authored2/6/12addition packages within the same original and native-unit/source construction. The content, length, entities and positions can change with dose. This is not an isolated event-count effect; omit the previously excluded plus_one_event from publication.

groups.label: Text length
groups.scope: These are the exact stored512/2048/8192target labels; compare only within-original complete sets. Natural_short/medium/long, min-dose repair names, longer_natural and longest_natural are additional distinct stored conditions, not silently pooled here. Counts/actual STATE length and source packages differ; not isolated token length.

groups.label: Repetition
groups.scope: Within-original2vs3of the exact declared repeated unit, retaining constructor/unit scope. Whole-body repetitions and single-fact repetitions are separate lineages. Native baseline is one copy only when the explicit original unit construction confirms it; no padding-matched isolation is assumed.

groups.label: Invented names
groups.scope: Use familiar vs invented only on exact paired originals with the same rename unit/constructor. Invented vs native original is a separate contrast on a larger cohort; do not treat native original as a universally familiar-name condition. Lexical/tokenization/name-specific changes remain.

groups.label: Irrelevant details
groups.scope: Compare exact low/high authored packages within original and source lineage. These need not share a universal number of details or word count. Native-to-addition contrasts include added content and length.

groups.label: Similar distractors
groups.scope: Compare exact low/high authored distractor packages within original/lineage. Semantic similarity is authored and reviewed, not a calibrated numeric scale; intensity and content can co-vary.

groups.label: Misleading details
groups.scope: Compare exact accurate/misleading attributed assessments within original and source lineage. Native is separate. This can test sensitivity to correct/incorrect suggestions; it is not a uniform narrative-summary or isolated trust manipulation.

groups.label: Unrelated examples
groups.scope: Each named control is an ACTUAL authored input, including absent. It must not be replaced with the native original. Keep prose_control, natural_prose and authored absent strata separate. Literal reference-token matching is recorded, not assumed; worked-example content and prose content differ. Native vs irrelevant additionally changes added context.

groups.label: Unrelated examples
groups.scope: Each named control is an ACTUAL authored input, including absent. It must not be replaced with the native original. Native vs irrelevant additionally changes added context.

groups.label: Unrelated examples

Keep prose_control, natural_prose and authored absent strata separate. Literal reference-token matching is recorded, not assumed; worked-example content and prose content differ. Native vs irrelevant additionally changes added context.

groups.label: Paraphrasing
groups.scope: Use exact paired surface/structural inputs within original/lineage; structural scope is source-specific and is not a uniform difficulty dose. Native is a separate control with explicit result provenance.

groups.label: Option order
groups.scope: Compare exact rotate_1/reverse/native choice presentations with stable option IDs. CLEF/CLEF Flash sort choices natively: these are preprocessing normalization controls, excluded from claims of learned option-order robustness. Reverse may alias rotate for two choices; flag equal hashes/native signatures and do not count them as independent.

groups.scope: The same context and evidence moved between beginning, middle and end.
